scope: National Dex species 1..493; base stats only.

criterion.boosted: Target base-stat total is higher than clean HeartGold.
criterion.redistributed: At least one base stat changed but the total is unchanged; excluded from the boosted filter.
criterion.lower_total: Target base-stat total is lower; excluded from the boosted filter.
criterion.excluded_claims: Type, ability, and move changes are not automatically classified as improvements.
